title: Gartner Hype Cycle for Life Science Commercial Operations 2020 — Overview and Priority Matrix
summary: Gartner evaluated 33 technology innovation profiles across the life science commercial operations landscape (ID: G00450345). The analysis provides maturity benchmarks for technologies relevant to CRM migration conversations, digital transformation planning, and competitive positioning.

report_metadata.scope: 33 innovation profiles spanning sales, marketing, patient engagement, data management, and emerging technologies in life science commercial operations

transformational_2_to_5_years: Artificial Intelligence in Life Science Commercial Operations
moderate_benefit_under_2_years: Predictive Analytics in Life Science Sales

cloud_computing.relevance: Cloud infrastructure maturity validates SaaS-first platform strategies. Life science companies no longer debate cloud vs. on-premise for commercial applications.

ai_commercial_operations.relevance: AI applied to next-best-action, call planning, content recommendation. Pre-dates the generative AI wave but signals the direction of CRM intelligence.

digital_life_science_platform.relevance: Describes the composable platform vision — PBCs (Packaged Business Capabilities) replacing monolithic CRM/ERP suites. Directly relevant to platform migration framing. Salesforce CIO among listed sample vendors (Amazon, Google, IBM, Microsoft, SAP).

multichannel_campaign_management.relevance: Orchestrating HCP engagement across in-person, email, digital, and remote channels. A core CRM capability for migration evaluation.

patient_engagement_hub.relevance: End-to-end patient journey management integrating multiple touchpoints. Differs from point patient support solutions by orchestrating across prediagnosis through ongoing care.

consent_preference_management.phase: On the Hype Cycle (position varies by market)
consent_preference_management.relevance: Regulatory requirement for HCP and patient communications. Critical for any CRM platform that handles opt-in/opt-out across channels.

precision_health.description: Predicting individual health by analyzing genetics, lifestyle, behaviors, biometrics, and medical history to identify risks and recommend interventions

prescribed_digital_therapeutics.description: Evidence-based, software-driven therapies requiring a prescription and FDA/EMA/MHRA regulatory approval for marketing claims. Examples include Sanofi/Happify Health (MS), Akili Interactive/Shionogi (ADHD), Click Therapeutics/Otsuka (CNS).

cell_gene_therapy_platform.description: Systems for collecting, analyzing, and preparing biological samples as therapies. Requires specialized chain-of-custody, manufacturing, and delivery logistics distinct from traditional pharma.
